title: Factory hardening: governed-write fallbacks, vocabulary subsets, advisory artifacts
summary: Three reusable rules from Pilot #3: (1) extend a governed-write fallback only for explicitly recoverable denial classes and let all other policy violations propagate fail-closed; (2) home a narrowed union vocabulary next to its superset (AccountOwnerKind ⊂ BindingOwnerKind), never in a sealed capability module; (3) document publication of advisory pipeline artifacts — uncommitted output is stale output until a chore PR lands it.
hint_triggers: Fallback gates that discriminate on error classes must enumerate exactly the recoverable denials (RESOURCE_PATH_SCOPE, persona write-denial) and propagate everything else; discrimination on message strings is fail-closed but fragile — prefer typed outcome codes when a third class appears. A subset vocabulary (person|organization) belongs beside its superset definition with a satisfies constraint plus a runtime test pinning the exclusion (operator), not inside sealed trusted-import capability modules which exist to expose admission APIs only. Pipeline-generated advisory reports (CURATION_REPORT.md) must state their publication contract in both the steward procedure and the artifact header: land each run via a chore PR, never treat uncommitted output as a pending decision.
